title: Architecture Service — Microsoft Defender for Cloud
author_notes: Architecture Service archetype (design/reference architecture). Complements DEFCSPM + MDCWP. Cross-references the existing DEFXDR unified-onboarding, DEFCSPM, DEFMDOP2, EOP/MDO hygiene, Cloud-App-DLP, SOCXDR and THREATHUNT solutions rather than duplicating them (gap-only). PowerShell (Graph Security / Az / Defender) + KQL. Licensing/plan/preview facts flagged verify; response actions approval-gated; regulatory/IR determinations deferred to the SOC.
